title: Half Marathon Races in Malaysia 2026: Full Calendar Guide
intro: Thirty-three half marathons run across Malaysia in the back half of 2026, with August and October each hosting ten races and forming the busiest stretch of the calendar. Putrajaya anchors the list with multiple events of its own, including the Garmin Run Marathon Series and CIDB Half Marathon, while the rest of the field spreads from Miri and Kota Kinabalu in the east to Jitra and Kota Bharu in the north and Kluang, Kulai and Mersing in the south. Most events pair the 21.1km distance with shorter 10km and 5km options. Choosing between them mostly means picking a state, a month, and whether you want a standalone half or a multi-distance race day.
